title: Jay Stratton's three-star slide shown to Congress

tellings.quote: Jay Stratton took this slide of three stars and presented it to people in Congress.

plain: A government official named Jay Stratton showed members of Congress a slide of what was presented as a UFO but was really just three stars, according to the UFO skeptic Mick West. West tells it without naming a source, placing it somewhere between 2019 and 2021. He offers it as an example of ordinary things being passed off to lawmakers as unexplained.
